mentions.name: Carryless
mentions.description: An open-source, free-forever pack manager for people who like outdoor activities and ultralight backpacking, focused on user experience with a clean and simple UI. Inspired by LighterPack.
mentions.problem: LighterPack, which inspired it, is left abandoned and its UI is quite hard to work with.
mentions.audience: People who like outdoor activities and ultralight weight backpacking enthusiasts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building https://carryless.org, a pack manager for people liking outdoor activities (and ultralight weight wheenies). It is focused on user experience, clean and simple UI. Open-source[1], free forever.
